title: Does the AEO ERM Integrate with other URA systems? - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Does the AEO ERM Integrate with other URA systems?
Yes, the AEO ERM will integrate and Interface with URA systems like Asycuda World, Ehub, Trade statistics Report, E-tax data and reports,Value reference guidelines, Tariff Specification codes, Audit reports (PCA, PAA, Spot / Issue, Joint audit reports), National and Regional AEO reports, Informer tips,Non- Intrusive Inspection Images, Verification accounts (VA’s), Seizure reports, Risk register template, Banks and other Financial Institutions to mention but a few. Information from these systems provide a 360 degree view of a tax payer.
